name: vulnsight-ai
description: Open-source dependency vulnerability scanner for npm and Python projects, powered by OSV.dev

scripts.start: npm run build:web && node bin/vulnsight.js serve
scripts.serve: npm run build:web && node bin/vulnsight.js serve
scripts.ui: npm run build:web && node bin/vulnsight.js serve
scripts.scan:examples: node bin/vulnsight.js test examples/npm-app && node bin/vulnsight.js test examples/python-app
